data.author: madbaron
data.body:
Follow-up to https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/413, where these two issues came up. They predate that PR, so they are fixed here against `main`.

data.title: Make PairCaloClustersPi0 more efficient.
data.author: scott-snyder
data.body:
PairCaloClustersPi0 tries to find all pairs of clusters with invariant mass consistent with the pi0 mass, subject to the constraint that no cluster is used by more than one pair.  It was doing this combinatoric problem by exhaustive search, which was exponential in both space and time. As a result, it was basically impossible to use the algorithm on hadronic events, as it would gobble up all available virtual memory.

The combinatoric problem is, however, equivalent to that of finding a maximum matching of a graph (<https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matching_(graph_theory)>). Boost.graph supplies an algorithm (Galil, https://doi.org/10.1145/6462.6502) that solves this in N^3 time (and i think linear space). Rewrite this algorithm to use this.

data.title: Remove filesystem detection and require GCC 9.1+
data.author: jmcarcell
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
 - CMake: Remove filesystem detection logic and require GCC 9.1+

ENDRELEASENOTES

TryFileSystem.cpp was being incorrectly installed to the cmake directory due to the `*.cpp` pattern in the install command.

GCC 9.1+ and libc++ from LLVM 9+ have full std::filesystem support without needing extra link libraries. The complex detection that tested stdc++fs, c++fs, and Boost::filesystem fallback was only needed for older compilers like GCC 8.

- Add a minimum GCC version check (9.1)
- Remove try_compile-based filesystem detection loop
- Remove Boost::filesystem fallback
- Delete cmake/TryFileSystem.cpp (no longer needed)
- Remove `*.cpp` from cmake install pattern
- Remove `FS_LIBRARIES` and the `USE_BOOST_FILESYSTEM` code path in GaudiPluginService
